jobs.description:
The selected candidate will be responsible for managing risks related to Asset Liability Management (ALM) and liquidity risk, ensuring that the company maintains a solid financial position and can navigate market challenges effectively.

Key Responsibilities:

• Conduct in-depth analysis of risks related to ALM and liquidity risk, identifying potential vulnerabilities and developing mitigation strategies

• Monitor the company's daily liquidity position, ensuring compliance with regulatory and internal requirements in alignment with Basel framework and FINMA ordinance

• Collaborate with treasury and finance departments to optimize liquidity management practices, including cash flow forecasting, liquidity buffer management and funding strategies/ contingency plan

• Assess and manage the company's exposure to interest rate risk in the banking book (IRRBB), developing strategies to mitigate adverse impacts on earnings and capital

• Conduct liquidity stress testing and scenario analysis to evaluate the impact of adverse market conditions on the company’s liquidity position

• Prepare detailed and accurate reports on liquidity risk and ALM for senior management, Committee, Regulators, providing clear analysis and recommendations

• Ability to work under pressure in a dynamic environment setting priorities and meet tiny deadlines

• Technical Skills: Advanced knowledge of ALM and liquidity risk, interest rate risk management tools and methodologies, including scenario analysis and stress testing

• Analytical Skills: Excellent analytical skills and attention to detail, with the ability to interpret and synthesize large volumes of complex data using programming knowledge (Phyton, R, SQL)

• Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present technical information clearly and concisely to non-technical stakeholders

• Experience: At least 3 years of experience in risk management, with a particular focus on ALM/ liquidity risk or treasury department

• Languages: Italian / English native proficiency / French / German is a plus

• Professional certification in risk management (e.g., FRM, PRM) is a plus

• Resident in Ticino or willing to relocate

descriptionByLocale.it:
Il candidato selezionato sarà responsabile della gestione dei rischi connessi alla gestione della responsabilità patrimoniale (Asset Liability Management - ALM) e del rischio di liquidità, assicurando che l'azienda mantenga una solida posizione finanziaria e possa affrontare efficacemente le sfide del mercato.

Responsabilità chiave:

• Effettuare un'analisi approfondita dei rischi connessi all'ALM e al rischio di liquidità, individuando le potenziali vulnerabilità e sviluppando strategie di mitigazione

• Monitoraggio della posizione di liquidità quotidiana dell'azienda, garantendo il rispetto dei requisiti normativi e interni in allineamento con il quadro di Basilea e l'ordinanza FINMA

• Collaborazione con i servizi di tesoreria e finanza per ottimizzare le pratiche di gestione della liquidità, comprese le previsioni sui flussi di cassa, la gestione dei buffer di liquidità e le strategie di finanziamento/piano di emergenza

• Valutare e gestire l'esposizione della società al rischio di tasso di interesse nel portafoglio bancario (IRRBB), sviluppando strategie per attenuare gli impatti negativi sui profitti e sui capitali

• Effettuare test di stress di liquidità e analisi degli scenari per valutare l'impatto delle avverse condizioni di mercato sulla posizione di liquidità dell'impresa.

• Preparare relazioni dettagliate e precise sul rischio di liquidità e ALM per i dirigenti di alto livello, il comitato, i regolatori, fornendo analisi e raccomandazioni chiare

• Capacità di lavorare sotto pressione in un ambiente dinamico che definisce le priorità e rispettare le scadenze minime

• Competenze tecniche: conoscenza avanzata di ALM e rischio di liquidità, strumenti e metodologie di gestione del rischio di tasso di interesse, tra cui analisi di scenari e test di stress

• Capacità analitiche: Ottime capacità analitiche e cura dei dettagli, con la capacità di interpretare e sintetizzare volumi elevati di dati complessi utilizzando conoscenze di programmazione (Phyton, R, SQL)

• Capacità di comunicazione: Forte capacità di comunicazione scritta e verbale, con la capacità di presentare informazioni tecniche in modo chiaro e conciso agli stakeholder non tecnici

• Esperienza: almeno 3 anni di esperienza nella gestione del rischio, con particolare attenzione al rischio di liquidità/ALM o al reparto tesoreria

• Lingue: Italiano / Inglese di competenza native / Francese / Tedesco è un plus

• La certificazione professionale nella gestione dei rischi (ad esempio, FRM, PRM) è un plus

• Residente a Ticino o disposto a trasferirsi

Der ausgewählte Kandidat ist für das Management von Risiken im Zusammenhang mit Asset Liability Management (ALM) und Liquiditätsrisiko verantwortlich, um sicherzustellen, dass das Unternehmen eine solide Finanzlage behält und Marktherausforderungen effektiv bewältigen kann.

Wichtige Aufgaben:

• Durchführung einer eingehenden Analyse der Risiken im Zusammenhang mit ALM und Liquiditätsrisiko, Ermittlung potenzieller Schwachstellen und Entwicklung von Minderungsstrategien

• Überwachung der täglichen Liquiditätslage des Unternehmens, um die Einhaltung regulatorischer und interner Anforderungen in Übereinstimmung mit Baseler Rahmen und FINMA-Verordnung zu gewährleisten

• Zusammenarbeit mit den Finanz- und Finanzabteilungen zur Optimierung der Liquiditätsmanagementpraktiken, einschließlich Cashflow-Prognose, Liquiditätspuffer-Management und Finanzierungsstrategien/Kontingenzplan

• Assess und Management der Risikobereitschaft des Unternehmens gegenüber dem Zinsrisiko im Bankenbuch (IRRBB), Entwicklung von Strategien zur Minderung der negativen Auswirkungen auf Ergebnis und Kapital

• Durchführung von Liquiditätsstresstests und Szenarioanalysen zur Bewertung der Auswirkungen ungünstiger Marktbedingungen auf die Liquiditätsposition des Unternehmens

• Erstellung detaillierter und genauer Berichte über Liquiditätsrisiken und ALM für die Geschäftsleitung, Ausschuss, Regulierungsbehörden, mit klaren Analysen und Empfehlungen

• Fähigkeit, unter Druck in einem dynamischen Umfeld zu arbeiten, das Prioritäten setzt und winzige Fristen erfüllt

• Technische Fähigkeiten: Fortgeschrittene Kenntnisse über ALM und Liquiditätsrisiko, Instrumente und Methoden für das Zinsrisikomanagement, einschließlich Szenarioanalyse und Stresstests

• Analytische Fähigkeiten: Ausgezeichnete analytische Fähigkeiten und Liebe zum Detail, mit der Fähigkeit, große Mengen komplexer Daten mit Programmierkenntnissen zu interpretieren und zu synthesieren (Phyton, R, SQL)

• Kommunikationskompetenzen: Starke schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, mit der Fähigkeit, technische Informationen nicht-technischen Akteuren klar und prägnant zu präsentieren

• Erfahrung: Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Risikomanagement, mit einem besonderen Fokus auf ALM/Liquiditätsrisiko oder Treasury-Abteilung

• Sprachen: Italienisch / Englisch Muttersprache / Französisch / Deutsch ist ein Plus

• Professionelle Zertifizierung im Risikomanagement (z.B. FRM, PRM) ist ein Plus

• Aufenthalt im Tessin oder Umzugswilligkeit

jobs.title: IT Auditor  - ref. 1087
jobs.description:
Reporting to the Head of IT Audit, you will be a key technical expert within the internal audit team. You will be operating in a bank where technology represents a key pillar of the business strategy, with a strong focus on the in-house development of proprietary banking solutions. Your primary mission is to conduct in-depth, risk-based audits across our modern and complex technology landscapes and evaluate IT risks, security controls, and regulatory compliance (FINMA). A central part of your role will be to actively pioneer the future of our audit function by developing and integrating advanced methodologies that leverage data analytics and agentic AI. For this role, we are seeking a hands-on IT Auditor with a strong background in the financial industry and a passion for technology and innovation. Swiss Domicile is mandatory.

•       Execute and Lead IT Audit Engagements: Take an active role in planning, executing, and reporting on risk-based audits covering information technology, infrastructure, data privacy, and information security.

•       Audit Modern Technology Landscapes: Perform in-depth assessments of IT processes, risks, and controls within a cutting-edge environment (AI, cloud, CI/CD pipelines), critically evaluating the design and effectiveness of the internal control system.

•       Shape Audit Strategy: Contribute your IT and security expertise to the risk-based audit planning process, helping to define key areas of focus and strategic priorities.

•       Enhance Audit Methodologies: Drive the modernization of our audit approaches by developing and integrating advanced techniques using data analytics and leveraging AI-driven tools to enhance audit effectiveness, increase assurance, and automate testing.

•       Collaborate on Joint Audits: Lead or assist in integrated audits with the business audit team and manage co-sourced audit engagements with external partners.

•       Support Ad-Hoc Projects: Work independently on ad-hoc assignments and special projects as required by management.

• Education & Certifications: A Bachelor's or master's degree in ICT or equivalent. A professional certification such as CISA, CISM, or CISSP is highly desirable, as is a commitment to obtaining one.

•       Core Experience: 4+ years of hands-on experience in a technical capacity (e.g., IT Audit, IT Security, IT Risk Management, or IT Compliance) within the Swiss financial industry.

•       Frameworks & Regulations: Strong knowledge of IT audit methodologies and frameworks (e.g., COBIT, ISO 27001, NIST) and a solid understanding of the Swiss regulatory landscape, or the willingness to rapidly develop this knowledge.

•       Data & AI: Relevant experience with data analytics tools (e.g., Python, SQL, Power BI), combined with the ability to develop and apply AI-driven solutions in an audit context, or a strong willingness to develop this capability.

•       Language Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills in both Italian and English are required. German language skills are a plus.

•       Key Competencies: Strong interpersonal and communication skills, the ability to explain complex technical issues to non-technical stakeholders, effective team collaboration, a capacity for rapid learning, and high adaptability to change.

•       Travel: Availability for travel approximately up to 10% within Switzerland and also abroad.

•       Mandatory Requirement: Domicile in Switzerland is required.

jobs.title: Legal Collection case Manager  - ref. 1095
jobs.description:
We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Legal Collections Specialist to join our team. You will be responsible for managing legal debt recovery

activities and supporting collection strategies within the framework of the Swiss Debt Enforcement and Bankruptcy Act (SchKG) and applicable

financial products and consumer finance regulations.

This role requires close collaboration with internal stakeholders, external legal partners, and debtors to maximize recovery outcomes while maintaining a professional and customer-focused approach

What We Offer

• Permanent position in a dynamic and international work environment.

• Competitive salary and benefits package.

• Workplace located in Wallisellen (Zurich), with the possibility of partial remote work (home office).

• Comprehensive onboarding and training program during the first three months at our Lugano office.

• Opportunities for professional growth and development within a growing organization.

Key Responsibilities

• Manage a portfolio of delinquent accounts and initiate, monitor, and follow up on legal debt recovery procedures.

• Prepare, review, and process legal documentation, maintain accurate case records, and monitor ongoing legal proceedings to ensure timely follow-up.

• Liaise with debtors, legal representatives, debt collection agencies, courts, and public authorities, and negotiate payment arrangements and settlement agreements where appropriate.

• Evaluate collection cases, recommend appropriate legal actions, and support the achievement of recovery targets.

• Collaborate with internal departments, including Customer Service, and contribute to the continuous improvement of collection processes and recovery strategies.

• At least 3 years of solid experience in debt collection management within the Swiss enforcement and judicial system (legal collection) is required.

• A strong understanding of Swiss debt enforcement and insolvency procedures, together with familiarity with financial products and consumer finance regulations, would be an advantage.

• Fluent French (C1 level, written and spoken) and good Italian skills (B2 level, written and spoken). Knowledge of German is considered an advantage.

• Strong goal-oriented mindset, organizational abilities, and problem-solving skills.

• The ability to work independently is essential, while also maintaining a strong team spirit and excellent communication with colleagues at the head office while working from a remote branch office.

• High attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office and case management systems.

• Commercial diploma or equivalent qualification (e.g., a degree in Swiss law, political science, or a related field).

Stiamo cercando un professionista esperto e attento ai dettagli per unirsi al nostro team all'interno di un ambiente bancario dinamico.

• Lavorare a stretto contatto con specialisti di marketing e trasformazione digitale per comprendere le loro esigenze in termini di dati per gestire e guidare le loro strategie di marketing.

• Sviluppare il profilo comportamentale dei clienti basato su dati demografici, utilizzo dei prodotti e punti di contatto multi-canale (dal digitale al call center).

• Mentalità analitica e orientata alla soluzione, eccellenti capacità di risoluzione dei problemi

• Personalità motivata e proattiva

• Eccellenti capacità di comunicazione. Fluente in italiano e inglese, tedesco è un vantaggio

jobs.description:
Cerchiamo un Consulente Fiscale esperto da inserire nella Divisione Private Banking. La figura sarà il punto di riferimento tecnico per la clientela privata e commerciale residente in Svizzera, ma non solo, lavorando in stretta sinergia con i consulenti alla clientela e lo specialista previdenziale svizzero, per offrire una consulenza patrimoniale integrata e di alto profilo.

Il candidato ideale possiede una profonda conoscenza della fiscalità svizzera e una spiccata attitudine alla consulenza diretta ("in salotto"), combinando competenza tecnica e capacità relazionali.

• Formazione: Laurea in Economia, Giurisprudenza o titolo equipollente. È preferibile il possesso di un Master in Fiscalità (o titolo equivalente di Esperto Fiscale).

• Esperienza: comprovata esperienza pregressa in ambito fiscale, preferibilmente presso banche, fiduciarie o studi di consulenza fiscale con esposizione a clientela privata e commerciale.

• Competenze Tecniche: conoscenza approfondita e aggiornata del sistema fiscale svizzero (imposte dirette, successioni, donazioni, imposta preventiva, ecc.) e principi di diritto fiscale internazionale.

• Lingue: Ottima padronanza di almeno due lingue nazionali (preferenza italiano/tedesco) e dell'inglese (scritto e parlato).

• Soft Skills:

• eccellenti capacità comunicative e attitudine alla relazione con il cliente.

• spiccata predisposizione al lavoro di squadra e alla condivisione delle competenze.

• autonomia, orientamento ai risultati e massima discrezione.

• capacità di sintesi e di traduzione di concetti tecnici complessi in soluzioni comprensibili per il cliente.

• Residenza in Ticino o volontà di trasferimento

Responsabilità principali
• Consulenza ai clienti: supportare i clienti nelle tematiche fiscali legate agli investimenti, alla pianificazione patrimoniale e successoria ed alle tematiche societarie;

• Collaborazione interdisciplinare: lavorare all’interno del Team di Consulenza fiscale e previdenziale in sinergia con il collega dedicato alla consulenza previdenziale per soddisfare esigenze e richieste dei clienti da un lato e supportare i Relationship Manager nell’analisi e nello sviluppo del book di clienti;

• Supportare i servizi operativi (PBBS) nella gestione e risoluzione di problematiche relative alle attestazioni fiscali svizzere ed estere, interfacciandosi quando necessario con l’Amministrazione federale delle contribuzioni (AFC);

• Gestire, analizzare e validare, d’intesa con il PBBS ed in linea con le rispettive competenze, gli attestati fiscali, garantendone correttezza e conformità normativa;

• Fornire supporto al Team Strategia di Investimento nell’ambito della fiscalità dei prodotti finanziari con particolare riferimento alla clientela residente in Svizzera ed in via residuale a clientela residente in mercati rilevanti per la Banca;

• Gestione network esterno: coordinarsi con studi legali e fiscali esterni per la gestione di casi complessi, tematiche di pianificazione successoria, protezione patrimoniale e per indirizzare il cliente qualora fossero necessarie consulenze specialistiche esterne al perimetro bancario.

• Aggiornamento continuo: monitorare costantemente l’evoluzione della normativa fiscale svizzera e internazionale, garantendo l'aggiornamento costante della banca e dei colleghi sui temi rilevanti.

• Autonomia operativa: gestire richieste e progetti in modo autonomo, garantendo un elevato standard di servizio e riservatezza.

• Supporto alla Banca: puntualmente potranno essere formulate richieste di primo supporto per tematiche fiscali svizzere inerenti all’applicazione di imposte preventiva, IVA, Tassa di bollo di negoziazione (lista non esaustiva) per i servizi di Corporate Center (Finanze) e Back-office mercati.

descriptionByLocale.en:
We are seeking an experienced Tax Advisor to join our Private Banking Division. The successful candidate will serve as the technical point of contact for private and commercial clients residing in Switzerland and beyond, working closely with client advisors and the Swiss pension specialist to provide integrated, high-level wealth management advice.

The ideal candidate possesses in-depth knowledge of Swiss taxation and a strong aptitude for direct client consulting (“face-to-face”), combining technical expertise with interpersonal skills.

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Law, or an equivalent degree. A Master’s degree in Taxation (or an equivalent qualification as a Tax Expert) is preferred.

• Experience: Proven prior experience in the tax field, preferably at banks, trust companies, or tax consulting firms with exposure to private and commercial clients.

• Technical Skills: In-depth and up-to-date knowledge of the Swiss tax system (direct taxes, inheritance, gifts, withholding tax, etc.) and the principles of international tax law.

• Languages: Excellent command of at least two national languages (preferably Italian/German) and English (written and spoken).

Soft Skills:

• Excellent communication skills and a knack for building client relationships.

• Strong aptitude for teamwork and sharing expertise.

• Independence, results-oriented mindset, and the utmost discretion.

• Ability to synthesize information and translate complex technical concepts into solutions that clients can understand.

• Resident in Ticino or willing to relocate

Key Responsibilities

• Client Consulting: Support clients on tax matters related to investments, wealth and estate planning, and corporate issues;

• Interdisciplinary Collaboration: Work within the Tax and Pension Advisory Team in synergy with the colleague dedicated to pension advisory services to meet clients’ needs and requests, while also supporting Relationship Managers in analyzing and developing the client portfolio;

• Support operational services (PBBS) in managing and resolving issues related to Swiss and foreign tax certifications, liaising with the Federal Tax Administration (FTA) as needed;

• Manage, analyze, and validate, in consultation with the PBBS and in accordance with respective areas of expertise, tax certificates, ensuring their accuracy and regulatory compliance;

• Provide support to the Investment Strategy Team regarding the tax treatment of financial products, with particular focus on clients residing in Switzerland and, to a lesser extent, clients residing in markets relevant to the Bank;

• External network management: coordinate with external law and tax firms to handle complex cases, estate planning matters, and asset protection, and to refer clients to external specialists when necessary.

• Continuous professional development: constantly monitor developments in Swiss and international tax regulations, ensuring that the bank and colleagues remain up to date on relevant issues.

• Operational autonomy: Manage requests and projects independently, ensuring a high standard of service and confidentiality.

• Bank Support: Requests for initial support may be submitted as needed regarding Swiss tax matters related to the application of withholding tax, VAT, and transaction stamp tax (non-exhaustive list) for the Corporate Center (Finance) and Markets Back Office services.
